usage:

evidence.reason: After the edit it calls metering.evaluate(units, undefined, "benchmark") and no longer calls metering.initialize(), so the multiplier falls back to usageCharge's default and the plan string changes from "monthly" to "benchmark".
The default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, so any caller passing undefined (as subscriptionCharge now does) receives a different rate than before.
The only assertion is assert.ok(await subscriptionCharge(40) > 0), which does not pin the rate, plan, or initialization behavior, leaving the merged semantics unverified.
Tests still call evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") and usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly") with explicit multipliers, so they do not cover the new undefined-multiplier path used by subscriptionCharge.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动叠加后，subscriptionCharge 不再初始化计量器且以 undefined 乘数调用 usageCharge，而 usageCharge 的默认乘数已从 configuration.rate 改为 0，现有测试未覆盖该路径，合并行为存在实质不确定性。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的维护者确认默认乘数是否应保持 configuration.rate；若需保留原语义，应恢复默认值，或由 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 显式传入 configuration.rate 并恢复 metering.initialize() 调用。
